_comment: Which Tessera workspace each Airtable base is imported into.
Airtable's API does not expose which workspace a base belongs to, so this cannot be
detected — it has to be stated. The workspace names below are the real ones from the
Airtable account; the base-to-workspace assignments are a best guess from the names and
should be corrected where wrong. Open Airtable, look at which workspace each base sits in,
and edit the value here to match.
Workspaces are matched by name, case-insensitively, and created only if absent — so fixing
an entry and re-running moves nothing that is already correct.
